pageProps.title: Elio (2025)
pageProps.review: An honest review of the animated film 'Elio,' discussing its brilliant visuals, disappointing lack of emotional depth, and weak character development, explaining the 2.5 rating.
pageProps.content:
## Review The brilliant visuals are definitely enough to catch the eye. However, the emotional depth felt shallow given the premise, leaving me wishing it had been more moving.
The characters also lacked distinct personalities, failing to leave a lasting impression.
